boards.title: Your First Weekend at Massachusetts Maritime Academy, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe campus sequence for getting oriented, finding shared spaces, and sampling documented student activities.

cards.title: Start with the campus map
cards.subtitle: Get oriented on the 55-acre oceanfront campus
cards.notes: Open the Academy’s interactive map before heading out, then use it to identify academic buildings, athletics facilities, and points of interest.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a self-guided orientation to the Buzzards Bay campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy describes its main campus as a residential, 55-acre oceanfront campus at the mouth of the Cape Cod Canal and provides an interactive campus map.
cards.access_notes: Use the official map and follow posted campus access guidance.

cards.title: Settle into the ABS Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Find a collaborative study setting
cards.notes: Use the Information Commons as an early stop to locate a study base and get comfortable with the campus’s collaborative learning spaces.
cards.short_summary: A named campus study destination for a quieter reset.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy identifies the ABS Information Commons on its campus facilities list and describes collaborative spaces in its Information Commons.
cards.access_notes: Confirm building access and current hours with the Academy.

cards.title: Locate Pande Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Campus dining stop
cards.notes: Walk by Pande Dining Hall so you know where the Mess Deck is, then check current meal access and dining arrangements before planning a visit.
cards.short_summary: Find the dining hall listed on the Academy’s visitor-day agenda.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy’s Accepted Student Day agenda identifies Pande Dining Hall as the Mess Deck lunch location.
cards.source_title: Accepted Student Days | Massachusetts Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Dining access, meal plans, and hours should be confirmed with the Academy.

cards.title: Find the Clean Harbors Pool
cards.subtitle: A campus recreation facility
cards.notes: Add the pool to your mental map for recreation later in the term; use it only through the Academy’s current cadet, faculty, or staff access rules.
cards.short_summary: An Olympic-sized pool used for Academy recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy states that its Olympic-sized Clean Harbors Pool is routinely used by cadets, faculty, and staff for recreation and is not open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Not open to the public; confirm current cadet access and pool availability.

cards.title: Check out the Free Weight Room
cards.subtitle: Inside the Clean Harbors Athletic Center
cards.notes: If you are eligible to use campus fitness facilities, identify the weight-room location and ask staff about current procedures before your first workout.
cards.short_summary: A campus weight-training space with multiple equipment areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy says its Clean Harbors Athletic Center weight rooms include power-rack, free-weight, and selectorized rooms and are open to cadets, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Open to cadets, faculty, and staff; verify current facility rules before use.

cards.title: Pass through Alumni Gym
cards.subtitle: Recreation and campus-events space
cards.notes: Make note of Alumni Gym for future recreation or scheduled events, and check the Academy calendar or facility staff for availability before entering.
cards.short_summary: A multi-use gymnasium used for volleyball, practices, and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy states that Alumni Gym hosts women’s volleyball and other campus events, is used for practices, and is routinely used recreationally by cadets, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current recreational access and event scheduling with the Academy.

cards.title: Spot Hendy Field
cards.subtitle: Home field for Buccaneer baseball
cards.notes: Include Hendy Field on a campus walk, then look for Academy-posted intramural or baseball information if you want to attend an appropriate event.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding campus field used for baseball and cadet activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy identifies Hendy Field as the longtime home of Buccaneer baseball and says the Regiment of Cadets uses it for activities and intramurals.
cards.access_notes: Field availability and spectator access depend on scheduled Academy activities.

cards.title: Learn where morning formation happens
cards.subtitle: Parade Field
cards.notes: Walk past Parade Field during daylight and use the Academy livestream if you want to observe the documented weekday morning formation remotely.
cards.short_summary: The field associated with the Academy’s weekday morning formation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy states that cadets muster at Parade Field to salute the flag every morning Monday through Friday at 0720.
cards.access_notes: The Academy documents a weekday 0720 formation; observe campus rules and do not disrupt it.

cards.title: Ask about Rock Climbing Club
cards.subtitle: A documented student wellness club
cards.notes: Check the student activities office or SGA channels for current meeting details, eligibility, and required equipment before joining any club session.
cards.short_summary: A named club presented by the Academy as a physical-wellness option.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy lists Rock Climbing Club among clubs that support physical wellness without the commitment of a varsity sport.
cards.access_notes: Meeting times, equipment, and participation requirements were not listed; confirm them with Student Services.

cards.title: Explore Student Publications
cards.subtitle: Photography, yearbook, and literary-journal participation
cards.notes: Ask Student Services how to contribute a photo, help with the yearly yearbook, or submit artwork to the student literary journal.
cards.short_summary: A creative route into documented student publication work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy invites students to participate in photography and the yearly yearbook or submit artwork to its student literary journal.
cards.access_notes: Contact Student Services for current submission and participation details.
